## Interactive Experiences

- [Earth Playground](https://luiskr.com/earth-playground): 3D photorealistic Earth WebGPU simulation engine with atmospheric scattering, dynamic lighting, real-time post-processing and interactive sci-fi controls (available in all languages: `/earth-playground` and localized slugs like `/br/playground-da-terra`).
- [Star Field](https://luiskr.com/star-field-experiment): three.js cosmic-navigation experiment — a simulated galaxy of 100k+ catalogued stars plus 134 authored bodies (solar system, exoplanet systems, deep-sky objects) with localized dossiers. Deep-link any body via `/star-field-experiment/<body-id>` (e.g. `/star-field-experiment/mars`); localized slugs like `/br/experimento-campo-estelar` also resolve.
- [Animations Reference](https://luiskr.com/animations): every animation on the site, described — element, motion, trigger, technology and purpose — as static readable markup (no JavaScript required). Localized slugs like `/br/animacoes` resolve; the same records drive runtime `aria-label`/`longdesc`/`aria-describedby` on the animated elements themselves.

## Documentation Portal

- [In-depth project docs](https://luiskr.com/docs): English-only browsable portal — architecture docs, quality reports, test coverage and the annotated source trees of every module. Every manifest file is a crawlable `/docs/<root>/<path>` route with JSON-LD (`TechArticle`/`CollectionPage` + `BreadcrumbList`) and in-DOM microdata.
- [Docs: Documentation root](https://luiskr.com/docs/docs): architecture, build, CMS and data-model guides, plus the repository story (`/docs/docs/modules.md`).
- [Docs: Quality reports](https://luiskr.com/docs/reports): lint, security and coverage gate outputs.
- [Docs: Test coverage](https://luiskr.com/docs/coverage): per-file istanbul HTML reports (plus `coverage-<module>` roots per package).
- [Docs: Source code](https://luiskr.com/docs/src): the published application source tree (copy-protected in the viewer). Additional source roots publish each module: `shared`, `core`, `website`, `cms`, `earth`, `starfield`, `docs-exp`, `desktop` and `local-modules` (vendored deps).

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [API catalog](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset — service-desc/service-doc/status relations.
- [OpenAPI description](https://luiskr.com/openapi.json): spec for the read-only endpoints (docs-content JSON, catalogs, sitemaps).
- [auth.md](https://luiskr.com/auth.md): authentication guidance — public endpoints require no credentials.
- [OAuth authorization-server metadata](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server) and [protected-resource metadata](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 8414/9728 — the site's protected surface (CMS) authenticates via Google sign-in on Firebase Auth.
- [A2A agent card](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent-to-agent discovery card.
- [Agent skills index](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): sha256-pinned SKILL.md files under `/meta/skills/`.
- [MCP server card](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): SEP-1649 card describing the read-only resource surface.
- [Message-signatures directory](https://luiskr.com/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory): Web Bot Auth JWKS for request-signature verification.
- Usage preferences: `Content-Signal` in `/robots.txt` (`ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=no`); `Link` response headers advertise these resources on every page.
